verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a virtual mailbox SaaS, and such services could plausibly offer an API or CLI for automation, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes management through a phone app or web portal. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, so nothing shows the product can run headlessly or in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
